    • empty: 0 items @ 0c
    • return: -1 items @ -100c
    ", ) def test_escaping_and_whitespace(self): items = [(' \n&', 1, -2)] self.assertEqual(text_receipt(items), ' \n&: 1 item @ -2c') self.assertEqual( html_receipt(items), "
    • <tea & "cake'>\n" "&: 1 item @ -2c
    ", ) def test_singular_uses_equality_not_type(self): items = [("float", 1.0, 5), ("bool", True, 6), ("string", "1", 7)] self.assertEqual( text_receipt(items), "float: 1.0 item @ 5c\nbool: True item @ 6c\nstring: 1 items @ 7c", ) self.assertEqual( html_receipt(items), "

    • bool: True item @ 6c
      • " "
    • string: 1 items @ 7c
    ", ) def test_single_pass_iterables(self): self.assertEqual(text_receipt(iter([("tea", 1, 20)])), "tea: 1 item @ 20c") self.assertEqual( html_receipt(iter([("tea", 1, 20)])), "
    • tea: 1 item @ 20c
    ", ) "}
